en.name: Hotel Resol Trinity Hakata
en.catchcopy: Safe, clean, and elegant—ideal for female solo travelers in the heart of Fukuoka.
en.description: Conveniently located just a 1-minute walk from Nakasu-Kawabata Station. This hotel features excellent security, an exclusive ladies-only floor, and a beautiful top-floor public bath. It provides a peaceful retreat while being steps away from Fukuoka's vibrant food scene and Tenjin shopping district.
en.access: 1 min walk from Nakasu-Kawabata Subway Station (Direct from Fukuoka Airport)

media.imageAlt: Elegant guest room at Hotel Resol Trinity Hakata

en.name: Super Hotel Premier Akihabara
en.catchcopy: Natural hot spring baths and superb transit access in central Tokyo.
en.description: Located just a 4-minute walk from Akihabara Station, this modern hotel features a relaxing natural hot spring bath, high-security keycode entry, and an organic breakfast buffet. Ideal for travelers looking for spotless rooms and effortless access to Tokyo Station, Ueno, and Shinjuku.
en.access: 4 min walk from JR Akihabara Station (Showa-dori Exit)

media.imageAlt: Clean modern room at Super Hotel Premier Akihabara

en.name: AB Hotel Kyoto Shijo Horikawa
en.catchcopy: Great value stay in central Kyoto with a relaxing public bath and easy bus/subway access.
en.description: Situated along Shijo Street in the heart of Kyoto, this clean and functional hotel offers a large communal bath and easy access to Nishiki Market, Gion, and Arashiyama via direct buses and nearby Hankyu/Subway stations.
en.access: 7 min walk from Hankyu Omiya Station or Shijo Subway Station
highlights: Direct Bus to Gion & Kyoto Sta.

media.imageAlt: Comfortable guest room at AB Hotel Kyoto Shijo Horikawa
